lines.zh: 我背着货走在村道上，步子很稳。
lines.en: I walk the village road with my pack, steady-footed.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩过泥，一直走到码头。
lines.en: My boots cross the mud all the way to the docks.

lines.zh: 我挨家挨户地走，边走边看门。
lines.en: I go house to house, eyeing each door.

lines.zh: 我沿维京长屋的墙根走。
lines.en: I walk the length of the Viking longhouse wall.

lines.zh: 我朝集市那边去，那儿人多。
lines.en: I head for the market where the crowd is.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边掂着货袋。
lines.en: I weigh the satchel at my hip as I walk.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷下摆扫过石子路。
lines.en: My cloak hem sweeps the cobbles.

lines.zh: 我停在路口，看了看风向。
lines.en: I stop at the crossing and read the wind.
I pass between the boat sheds.
I walk toward the fresh smoke.

lines.zh: 我绕开那群羊，继续往前。
lines.en: I go around the flock and walk on.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数着人家的门牌。
lines.en: I count the house markers as I go.

lines.zh: 我蹲在货堆旁边，等人来问。
lines.en: I crouch by my goods and wait to be asked.

lines.zh: 我把那本书从袋子底下摸出来。
lines.en: I work the book out from the bottom of the bag.

lines.zh: 海风把帆布吹得一阵响。
lines.en: The sea wind snaps the canvas.
I am seeing which chimneys smoke.

lines.zh: 我的货物摆得整整齐齐。
lines.en: My goods are laid out neatly.
I have rolled this map three times.

lines.zh: 有人从长屋门口出来，我抬眼。
lines.en: Someone came out of the longhouse and I look up.

lines.zh: 我在等一个见过龙的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who has seen a dragon.

lines.zh: 我把一枚铁片在手里转着。
lines.en: I turn a scrap of iron in my fingers.

lines.zh: 码头那边有船要靠岸了。
lines.en: A boat is coming in at the dock.

lines.zh: 我数了数今天卖出去几样东西。
lines.en: I count what I have sold today.
Sand has got into my boot.

lines.zh: 天色还早，我还能再走两个村。
lines.en: Still early. I can make two more villages.

lines.zh: 我把货袋的绳子重新系紧。
lines.en: I retie the cord on the satchel.

lines.zh: 你手上那点铁，我看见了。
lines.en: I can see that iron in your hand.
Not everyone runs into me.
Are you buying a book, or directions?
You will not find this anywhere else.

lines.zh: 你先把手里的铁收起来。
lines.en: Put that iron away first.

lines.zh: 我这儿只做买卖，不结仇。
lines.en: I only trade. I make no enemies.

lines.zh: 你要问龙的事，那就对了。
lines.en: If it is dragons you ask about, you came right.
You carry a fresh smell of fire.
I have sold this map six times over.
You do not look wealthy.

lines.zh: 你要的东西，我这里正好有。
lines.en: I happen to have what you want.
I stay here one night only.
My satchel has been cut open.

lines.zh: 铁锭一到手，我就有货卖。
lines.en: The moment I get iron, I have wares to sell.
My pack is intact; my shoulder swells first.
Blood dripped on the wares. I wipe it.
I hold my side and keep reckoning.
That is too great a loss.
I crouch and catch my breath.
I have that one filed away.
I saw who did it.

lines.zh: 我这本册子，只卖给有铁的人。
lines.en: This book only sells to someone with iron.
You would trade that? I do not lose on it.
I have weighed that in my hand.
I cannot come down on that price.
Add one more thing and we trade.
I do not take that. Too light.

lines.zh: 这味道像是从船上来的。
lines.en: That smells like it came off a boat.

lines.zh: 我的价钱公道，你问谁都一样。
lines.en: My prices are fair. Ask anyone.

lines.zh: 你把东西放桌上，我们慢慢算。
lines.en: Put it on the table and we will reckon.
I might be able to move this.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我还当你是老手。
lines.en: Do not shake. I took you for a professional.

lines.zh: 看着点，我这一袋货不轻。
lines.en: Careful. This satchel is not light.
You knocked my map down.
Step aside. I am passing.
That bump I will let pass.
The dock is crowded. Do not push.
Half my goods are scattered.
You are standing on my wares.
Let us each keep to one side.
That knocked me back a step.
This alley fits one person.

lines.zh: 我常年在外，家里没人等。
lines.en: I am always on the road. Nobody waits at home.

lines.zh: 有个织帆的女人认得我。
lines.en: A sailmaker's woman knows me.

lines.zh: 我每年回一次那个村子。
lines.en: I go back to that village once a year.
She says I should stop running boats.

lines.zh: 我把最好的铁片留给她。
lines.en: I keep the best piece of iron for her.
We never married, and never parted.

lines.zh: 她织的帆比我走的船结实。
lines.en: Her sails outlast the boats I sail.
I stop one night at her door.

lines.zh: 这次回去，我会多留两天。
lines.en: This time I will stay two days longer.

lines.zh: 海上的事，我从不跟她细说。
lines.en: I never tell her the details of the sea.
I stoop and pick up the map.

lines.zh: 这一小块铁，能换点东西。
lines.en: A scrap of iron like this buys something.
I pick up the coin from the ground.
This clasp is still sound.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进货袋最底下。
lines.en: I tuck it to the bottom of the satchel.
I will take that scrap of canvas.
This one has a history to it.
I set the stall back upright.
I can sell this much.

lines.zh: 我什么都收，只要够分量。
lines.en: I take anything, provided it has weight.
Someone is hammering iron over there.

lines.zh: 第一次拿到铁的人，我都会出现。
lines.en: I show up for whoever first gets iron.

lines.zh: 他在门口站着，手里有东西。
lines.en: He stands at the door with something in his hand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过去，不急着开口。
lines.en: I walk over slowly and do not speak first.
He will not walk away from this distance.

lines.zh: 我把书从袋里摸出一角。
lines.en: I let a corner of the book show.
He has seen the book.

lines.zh: 他的眼睛跟着我的手走。
lines.en: His eyes follow my hand.
I stop three paces from him.

lines.zh: 我把地图卷好，握在手里。
lines.en: I roll the map and hold it.
He glanced my way.
He is walking over.
Better this way. I need not chase.

lines.zh: 我站住，把货袋放在地上。
lines.en: I stop and set the satchel down.
My eyes stay on his hands.
He is feeling at his belt.
I raise the book to half height.
He has not walked off.
He asked the first question.
I answer slowly and let him wait.
He leans half a step closer.
I unroll the map a little.
His eyes settle on the map.
He says the price is too high.
I am in no hurry. I wait.
He is reaching into his purse.
I count how much he has left.
He sets his goods on the table.
That will about do it.
I swing the satchel up as a shield.
He grabs for it and I pin his hand.
That was not a blow. It was a block.
I tuck the map inside my coat.
He shoves and I give only half a step.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的手腕拧过去。
lines.en: I catch his wrist and turn it.
The pain makes him let go.
I stuff the goods back in the bag.
He comes again and I raise a hand.
This time he backs off.

lines.zh: 我把摊子往后拖了两步。
lines.en: I drag the stall back two paces.
The deal is dead. I accept it.
I pick up the fallen coin and go.
A fight is the worst kind of business.

lines.zh: 我背着袋子走进这个村子。
lines.en: I walk into this village with my pack.

lines.zh: 是有人第一次敲出了铁。
lines.en: Someone has hammered out iron for the first time.
I never come early, nor late.
My boat waits beyond the harbour.

lines.zh: 我把货摊支在长屋旁边。
lines.en: I set my stall by the longhouse.

lines.zh: 这里的人还不知道我卖什么。
lines.en: These people do not yet know what I sell.
I lay out the book and the map.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷抖了抖，沙掉下来。
lines.en: I shake my cloak and sand falls out.

lines.zh: 集市上的人朝我这边看。
lines.en: People in the market look my way.
I sit and wait.
I take this road twice a year.
Half my cargo is still aboard.
Someone is working iron, and the sound is new.
I set the wares straight.

lines.zh: 这个村子比上次大了些。
lines.en: This village is a little larger than last time.

lines.zh: 我先看看有几个人识货。
lines.en: First I see how many know good goods.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的斗篷，我拍打。
lines.en: Fire caught my cloak and I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我从码头边摔下去，摔得闷。
lines.en: I fell off the dock and landed hard.

lines.zh: 海水灌进嘴里，我挣着浮。
lines.en: Seawater filled my mouth and I fought up.
The blast threw me into the goods.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进了我的袋子。
lines.en: An arrow stands in my satchel.
That strange light unsteadied my feet.

lines.zh: 路上没吃东西，我又干又瘦。
lines.en: Nothing to eat on the road. I am dry and thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我一哆嗦。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I jerked.

lines.zh: 铁砧跟着我，一起坠下去。
lines.en: The anvil falls with me.
